description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment: 2001/14 of 11.01.2017, Wegiriya,  Harispattuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320460
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple entries updating land ownership records, changing property ownership from "Private" or "Land Reform Commission" to specific individuals, and correcting land extent measurements. The content is entirely focused on land and property matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
